config_files.notes: Stores machine-local graphics, rendering pipeline, DLSS/FSR upscaling, window mode, and resolution settings. Overwritten by in-game Graphics menu. Edit only while Enshrouded is closed.
Stores user gameplay, accessibility, HUD aspect ratio constraints (hudAspectRatioWidth), camera shake, and input bindings.

keys.effect: Horizontal aspect ratio constraint for HUD/UI elements. Setting to 21 bounds the UI to a 21:9 horizontal window on super-ultrawide (32:9) screens.
keys.notes: Native ultrawide HUD centering feature in Keen Engine. Prevents health, stamina, and hotbar from stretching to the far edges of 32:9 (5120x1440) monitors.

keys.effect: Screen shake strength from explosions, boss attacks, and mining impacts.
keys.notes: Setting to '0' completely disables violent camera jarring, significantly improving comfort for photosensitive and motion-sensitive players.

keys.effect: Peripheral frost effect when entering freezing mountainous areas.
keys.notes: Disabling removes heavy visual noise, edge flicker, and tunnel vision.
Quality mode provides clean, native-comparable 1440p rendering with excellent temporal stability on RTX 40-series hardware.
Dynamic GI on 'Ultra' is a major GPU compute bottleneck at 5120x1440. Dropping to 'High' delivers visually identical lighting while recovering 15-25% GPU headroom to lock 60FPS+.
GPUs with 12GB+ VRAM (e.g. RTX 4070 SUPER) run High textures without frame pacing stutter.

keys.effect: Voxel terrain geometry LOD distance and mesh density: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High'.
keys.notes: Setting to 'Medium' or 'High' eliminates distracting terrain pop-in during fast travel and gliding.

keys.effect: Volumetric fog quality in Shroud biomes: 'Low', 'Medium', 'High'.
keys.notes: The Shroud is the most GPU-intensive zone in Enshrouded. Low or Medium fog maintains stable framerates without compromising eerie atmosphere.
Disabling bloom prevents intense light flares from Shroud roots, magical spells, and torches.
Keeps render queue latency minimal for responsive combat on NVIDIA RTX hardware.

manual_only_settings.reason: Enshrouded supports 32:9 natively with correct horizontal field-of-view.

notes: Enshrouded 1.0 uses modern JSON configuration files (enshrouded_local.json in the game root and enshrouded_user.json in Saved Games), completely replacing early-access graphics.cfg.
Keen Engine natively supports ultrawide HUD aspect ratio clamping (hudAspectRatioWidth: 21) out-of-the-box.
Dynamic GI 'Ultra' has an exponential cost curve; 'High' is recommended for smooth 60FPS+ at 5120x1440.
